title: Brugada Launches 'Código 1' Proximity Policing Strategy as August Posts Fewest CDMX Homicides in 29 Years
detail: Jefa de Gobierno Clara Brugada launched 'Código 1, la policía en tu calle,' deploying 2,044 patrol units and 8,176 officers on foot-and-vehicle rounds across 1,022 redrawn police cuadrantes citywide; officers must walk each street, contact residents registered as 'enlaces de paz,' and log the visit in a logbook neighbors sign to verify the patrol occurred. Brugada paired the launch with the announcement that August 2026 closed as CDMX's lowest-homicide August in 29 years, citing the acquisition of 3,500 new patrol vehicles and a nearly 50% expansion of the city's camera network to 120,000 units.

media.caption: Clara Brugada announces the 'Código 1' proximity policing strategy and August's 29-year homicide low
